risk_if_not_implemented: Without In-Person or Trusted Third-Party Registration, supplier and External Service Provider (ESP) weaknesses, incidents or failures may propagate into the organization's environment unmanaged. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Pandemic (Disease) Outbreaks (NT-7); Human Error (MT-9), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Cryptographic Key Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate cryptographic key management controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of keys.
compensating_control_1.justification: Cryptographic Key Management (CRY-10) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of In-Person or Trusted Third-Party Registration (IAC-05.1) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Authenticator Management
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to:
(1) Securely manage authenticators for users and devices; and
(2) Ensure the strength of authentication is appropriate to the classification of the data being accessed.
compensating_control_2.justification: Authenticator Management (IAC-14) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of In-Person or Trusted Third-Party Registration (IAC-05.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
